NY POST: World Cup brings temporary peace to violence-ravaged Mexico — as cartels seemingly shift focus
June 20, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Mexico's murder rate just hit a decade low. NY Post's explanation? A "cartel truce." Not 100,000 troops. Not Plan Kukulkan. Not the May 11-year homicide low that landed BEFORE the World Cup kicked off. When the data is good, gringo media credits the criminals.

The May 2026 daily homicide rate hit 47.3 — an 11-year low recorded weeks before kickoff. The drop is a year-long trend Sheinbaum's security cabinet has been documenting, not a tournament special.

• "It seems there is a sort of a World Cup truce" — David Saucedo, analyst
• "drug trafficking groups… decided to take advantage of the World Cup… to focus on their criminal activities and boost profits"
• "There are no arrests of high-profile drug traffickers, no announcements of major seizures, and no significant operations against criminal organizations"

🔥🇲🇽 <u>FINANCIAL FRAUD UP 19% IN MEXICO JAN-MAY 2026 — 237 COMPLAINTS A DAY, JÓVENES NOW TOP TARGET</u>

CONDUSEF: 35,762 fraud complaints registered Jan-May 2026, up 18.95% vs the same period last year — 237 per day. The banking sector took 34,325 of them, +18%. Sofipos — Nu, Klar, Stori and friends — saw a 48% spike. Complaints from 18-29 year-olds rose ~20%, a generational shift from the years when elders were the prime target. "This reflects an expansion of the phenomenon toward new segments of users and financial services," said CONDUSEF president Óscar Rosado. 96% of fraud still hits traditional banking — the fintech disruption sold to Mexicans is mostly old-school theft in a slicker app.

🇲🇽🚆 <u>PROGRESO PORT EXPANDS — 80-HECTARE PLATFORM, DREDGED TO 13.3M, 948 MDP PRIVATE INVESTMENT IN PHASE 2</u>

SEMAR Secretary Raymundo Pedro Morales Ángeles closed Phase 1 dredging at Puerto de Altura Progreso and launched Phase 2 — 948 million pesos in private investment, channel depth pushed to 13.3 meters, dock extended from 332 to 450 meters. The full design: 80 hectares hosting a shipyard plus terminals for mineral bulk, liquefied gas, petroleum, and containers. "The beginning of the construction of the Renacimiento Maya," SEMAR said. Joins the Maya Train, Cuxtal II gas pipeline, O'Horán Hospital, and Mérida IV power plant — Yucatán becoming the Peninsula's strategic port hub, not Miami's appendix.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>ANAM CUSTOMS OFFICIAL ARRESTED AT MATAMOROS BRIDGE — 4T ANTI-CORRUPTION REACHES THE BORDER POSTS</u>

Carlos Eugenio Benítez Orta, 46, an official of Mexico's National Customs Agency (ANAM), was detained at the Matamoros "Puerta México" international bridge for organized crime ties. Mexican SSPC, the FGR Criminal Investigation Agency, and ANAM agents executed the apprehension order in coordination with US authorities; he was transferred to Federal Penitentiary No. 1 "Altiplano" in the State of Mexico. The National Intelligence Center built the case. Calderón gave us Genaro García Luna; Sheinbaum's federal agencies eat their own corrupt customs officers.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>RIGHT-WING DESTABILIZATION CAMPAIGN INTENSIFIES DURING WORLD CUP — ARGENTINE + SPANISH ULTRAS + US EMBASSY NAMED</u>

Contralínea documents a coordinated disinformation network targeting Mexico during the FIFA World Cup. Argentine far-right operative Fernando Cerimedo (La Derecha Diario), Spanish ultra Javier Negre (OkDiario, EDATV), CIA/DEA intermediaries, and Chihuahua governor Maru Campos pushed "failed state" and "narco-state" narratives via bot farms and black propaganda. "It is not a sum of isolated efforts but a structured ecosystem," said Luisa María Alcalde, Sheinbaum's legal counsel. The tournament that is bringing millions of tourists to Mexico is also the moment the empire most wants to break the country's image.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>55 BILLION PESOS DIRECT TO INDIGENOUS COMMUNITIES — FAISPIAM NOW CONSTITUTIONALLY AUTONOMOUS</u>

Federal government has channeled over 55 billion pesos into 21 regional justice and development plans for Mexico's indigenous peoples, reaching more than 3,000 communities. FAISPIAM — the Fund for Social Infrastructure for Indigenous and Afro-Mexican Peoples — rises from 12.5 billion in 2025 to 13.5 billion in 2026, now constitutionally recognized as an autonomous budget level decided directly by community assemblies. No state government, no municipal president, no NGO middleman. 432 artisanal roads already built with 20 billion pesos invested; 6 billion more planned this year.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>SHEINBAUM OPENS CBTIS 290 IN TIJUANA — 200K NEW BACHILLERATO SPOTS, AI / ROBOTICS / SEMICONDUCTOR FOCUS</u>

From Tijuana on June 20, Sheinbaum cut the ribbon on CBTIS 290 — Mexico's first public high school specialized in artificial intelligence, robotics, and semiconductors. Two student-built robots (a humanoid and a robot dog) accompanied her on stage. The plant cost 66.5 million pesos, serves 540 students per shift, and is part of the new Bachillerato Nacional Margarita Maza model adding 200,000 new high school spaces nationwide this year. Built by the Mexican state — not Intel, not Apple, not the maquila.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MUNDIAL OPENING DAY: RESTAURANT SALES +23% — CANIRAC PROJECTS +29% JUNE-JULY, 836K TOURISTS, 39K NEW JOBS</u>

OpenTable data show Mexican restaurant sales jumped 23 percent on the Mundial 2026 opening day. Canirac, the National Restaurant Chamber, now projects sales will rise up to 29 percent across June and July — with 28 percent of all establishments already reporting above-normal sales after the first match, and the strongest performers (cantinas and restaurant-bars with promos) hitting 40-50 percent spikes. The industry forecasts 836,000 incoming tourists, 39,000 new restaurant-sector jobs, and an additional 562 million USD in local consumption — across 206,000 food and beverage establishments nationwide. The "tres sedes" model Sheinbaum negotiated is delivering, with the derrama distributed across three Mexican cities rather than concentrated in a single hotel corridor as in Brazil 2014.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>PAN ALCALDESA ALESSANDRA ROJO DE LA VEGA SNATCHED THE ACTIVIST WHO FILMED HER ZONA ROSA OPERATIVO</u>

Cuauhtémoc's PAN borough mayor had Luis Fernando "Cheems" Luna grabbed outside his home on June 17 and held incommunicado for 4 hours at FGJ-CDMX before public pressure forced his release. His lawyer says the cops told him at arrest, "te metiste con alguien muy pesado" — Luna had filmed the violent operativo Rojo de la Vega's staff ran against informal street vendors on Calle Génova in Zona Rosa. Morena diputada Diana Sánchez Barrios confirmed the violence was started by the alcaldía's own staff, not the comerciantes. PAN-CDMX immediately ran cover, calling Rojo de la Vega "the assaulted one." This is what the right-wing opposition does the moment it touches power — persecute journalism, jail dissent, invert the victim.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>ALBERTO "VIRUS" RODRÍGUEZ — NUEVO IMPERIO BOSS BEHIND AZCAPOTZALCO VIOLENCE — DETAINED IN HIDALGO</u>

A coordinated federal-CDMX operation tracked Alberto Rodríguez, alias "Virus," from Azcapotzalco to Tulancingo, Hidalgo, where authorities arrested him without firing a shot. Investigators identify him as a leader of the Nuevo Imperio cell that triggered the recent spike in violence in the Mexico City borough. Brugada's CDMX administration reports high-impact crime down 65 percent vs. 2019 across the city — including a 51 percent drop in homicides and 16 alcaldías now showing reductions. This is what the Conferencia Nacional para la Construcción de Paz looks like in practice: arrests over executions, intelligence over Calderón-era theatrics.
